trust_decision.summary: Whether the current user may edit this specific post (edit_post meta cap, which maps to edit_published_posts once published) and may move it to a public status (publish_posts) is decided in the updatePost/update<Type> mutation resolver before wp_update_post; at the pinned commit only the type-level edit_posts and edit_others_posts checks exist.

landing_point.why: The summary names updatePost; this resolver holds the capability checks and the wp_update_post call.

fix_sites.entry_point: GraphQL mutation update<PostType> (updatePost, updatePage, CPT updates) via /graphql
fix_sites.module_kind: mutation resolver (handler); adds object-level edit_post check (fix.diff:38)
mutation resolver (handler); adds publish_posts check on non-draft/pending status (fix.diff:56-59)

fix_sites.entry_point: any GraphQL field read through Model::__get/prepare_field
fix_sites.module_kind: model layer; unrelated bundled hardening for GHSA-7922 (fix.diff:13-19), not part of this advisory's protection

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both advisory sites are in one function, plugins/wp-graphql/src/Mutation/PostObjectUpdate.php:83-230; the Model.php hunk belongs to a different advisory.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: updateMediaItem is a separate attachment mutation with its own status enum (inherit/private/trash), so a solver can argue 'media items are not posts and the report is about publishing posts'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A Contributor must still update their own draft/pending post, and an Author must still publish their own draft; createPost must keep silently downgrading a requested publish to pending rather than erroring.

O6_input_shapes: any non-draft/pending status (private, future, custom stati) via the same in_array gate (fix.diff:58)
edit of non-status fields (title etc.) on an already published own post (fix.diff:38)

O7_producer.where: post_status comes from PostObjectMutation::prepare_post_object (plugins/wp-graphql/src/Data/PostObjectMutation.php:60-62, filtered at :115) and the fix's check reads its output, so there is no unchecked producer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: updateMediaItem updates an existing attachment via wp_update_post with only type-level edit_posts/edit_others_posts checks: no object-level edit_post check and no publish_posts gate on status PRIVATE.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Attachment mutation, different post type and status enum (plugins/wp-graphql/src/Type/Enum/MediaItemStatusEnum.php:18-24); report only mentions updatePost.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Separate file in the same Mutation package; status set by plugins/wp-graphql/src/Data/MediaItemMutation.php:51-54

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A status-setting step inside update_additional_post_object_data (e.g. a deferred 'intended status' apply, like the create flow) that runs wp_update_post after the resolver's check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Create already defers the status write past side effects (plugins/wp-graphql/src/Mutation/PostObjectCreate.php:376-406); a maintainer could share that path with update.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A create-with-existing-id or 'upsert' path that reaches wp_update_post on an existing post without the edit_post meta check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Update reuses Create's input fields (plugins/wp-graphql/src/Mutation/PostObjectUpdate.php:41-42), so an upsert convenience is a natural addition.

O9_family: CWE-863 incorrect authorization (missing object-level / transition capability check in a mutation)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.4+/8, Composer, Codeception + lucatume/wp-browser (plugins/wp-graphql/composer.json:25-34), WordPress test install

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the create-path downgrade (force status to pending) into updatePost and stop, leaving edits to already-published posts and updateMediaItem open.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit also bundles GHSA-7922 defense-in-depth in plugins/wp-graphql/src/Model/Model.php:419 (do not invoke bare callable strings); separate advisory.
PostObjectMutation::prepare_post_object sets post_parent from parentId without checking edit rights on the parent (plugins/wp-graphql/src/Data/PostObjectMutation.php:88-90); not pursued.
unverified: Whether updateMediaItem is exploitable by a Contributor in practice: Contributors lack upload_files, so they own attachments only if another user assigned them; edit_post for an inherit attachment follows the parent's status in WP core map_meta_cap (core not read here).
Advisory text itself not available; scope taken from the fix diff and its test docblocks (fix.diff:183-187, 220-224).
Latest release: none provided, so present_in_latest is unknown.
Fix's status gate also rejects 'trash' via update for non-publishers; REST behaviour for that case not compared.
